events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors will support write, update and delete actions
events.titleJa: Federated Copilot Connectors は、書き込み、更新、および削除アクションをサポートします。
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors will support write, update and delete actions
events.summary: Federated Copilot connectors (MCP type) currently let Microsoft 365 Copilot read data from third-party services in real time. With this update, the connector tools that create, update, and delete content in those services are unblocked in Copilot Chat, so users can complete work without leaving Copilot. Copilot acts...
events.summaryJa: Federated Copilot コネクタは、サードパーティ サービスのデータをリアルタイムに読み取れるほか、Copilot Chat からコンテンツを作成・更新・削除できるようになります。
events.summaryEn: Federated Copilot connectors (MCP type) currently let Microsoft 365 Copilot read data from third-party services in real time. With this update, the connector tools that create, update, and delete content in those services are unblocked in Copilot Chat, so users can complete work without leaving Copilot. Copilot acts...

events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
events.titleJa: Copilot チャットのプランナー機能 (Microsoft Copilot)
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
events.summary: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.
events.summaryJa: Microsoft Copilot チャットで Planner タスクと Planner 情報をクエリする計画の作成をサポートし、ユーザーが Copilot と Planner の間でタスクと計画をシームレスに管理できるようにします。
events.summaryEn: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.
